backgrounds.name: Futuristic Showroom
backgrounds.prompt: a sleek futuristic car showroom interior, empty, wide reflective floor, dramatic spotlights, moody atmosphere, no vehicles, no text, no logos

videos.name: American Flag Waving
videos.note: 7.0s / 25fps CGI loop. Its final frame is pure black; imaging/compose/hero_video.py::_trim_dark_edges() drops that automatically, so don't re-encode this file to 'fix' it by hand.

audio.name: Its Mine
audio.note: Operator-produced seamless 4-bar loop (refrain: 'its mine'). hero_video.py derives the carousel's bar and the hero's beat pulse by dividing this file's measured duration by `bars` then by 4 beats -- so `bars` MUST match the file or every cut drifts off the downbeat.
